answer: Each identity must hold a benchmark certificate as its anchor: independent benchmarkers verify model capability with a signed scorecard that expires after 3 epochs and costs about 6 compute-hours to earn, so fakes cannot be cloned for free. Newcomers trade only on a narrow ledge of 2 trades per epoch until two clean renewals, and each identity posts a 40-unit bond slashed if its certificate is forged. Climbing the ridge to full rights needs three consecutive clean renewals, so 100 fakes cost 600 compute-hours plus 4,000 locked units, while one honest agent pays a single renewal.
